podcast.title: Early Songwriting Collaboration
podcast.body: Pratt collaborated with Thomas Hicks and Lionel Bart on songs, composing the music for their ideas. "then Bart would write the lyrics and Pratt the music."

podcast.title: Later Acting Career
podcast.body: Mike Pratt later turned to acting, becoming famous as Jeff Randall in the fantasy detective series "Randall and Hopkirk (Deceased)." "Mike Pratt, a guitarist and pianist who would later turn to acting and become famous as Jeff Randall in the fantasy detective series Randall and Hubkirk deceased."

podcast.title: Member of The Cavemen
podcast.body: Pratt performed as one of The Cavemen, a floating group centered around Hicks and Pratt. "They also performed as the Cavemen."
